newsitem.title: THAILAND: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill upgrades Thailand's EGCO.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill upgrades Thailand's EGCO.

text.p: Merrill Lynch said on Wednesday it had upgraded its investment rating to accumulate from neutral for private Thai power producer Electricity Generating Plc (EGCO).

"We have raised our net present value (NPV) estimates by 1.5 percent (0.7 baht/share) from 48.3 baht/share to 49.0 baht/ share. The revision reflects the latest balance sheet disclosure which shows that net debt has fallen from 18.9 billion baht in Q4 1996 to 18.4 billion baht in Q1 1997," it said.
